title: Present Simple
summary: Use Present Simple to talk about routines, habits and facts.

explanation.en: We use Present Simple for routines, habits and facts that are generally true.
explanation.ru: Present Simple используется для регулярных действий, привычек и фактов.

examples.en: She goes to school every day.
examples.ru: Она ходит в школу каждый день.

forms.label: Negative
forms.pattern: I/You/We/They don't work. He/She/It doesn't work.

examples.en: He doesn't get up late on school days.
examples.ru: В учебные дни он не встаёт поздно.

forms.label: Questions
forms.pattern: Do I/you/we/they work? Does he/she/it work?

examples.en: Does she have breakfast at home?

commonMistakes.wrong: She go to school every day.
commonMistakes.right: She goes to school every day.
commonMistakes.note: With he, she and it, the verb usually takes -s.
After does, use the base form of the verb.
